videos.desc: Three roped mountain climbers in colorful jackets push forward step by step up a snowy ridge, advancing toward an orange flag planted on the summit; they reach the top together and throw their arms up in triumph.
videos.said: Come on! Keep coming! We made it!

videos.desc: A 3D-animated young man with a coffee and shoulder bag runs to catch a morning tram, yawns while holding a strap among passengers, walks into a glass office building, and in the evening rides back and cheers with relief outside his home.

Three modified black, grey and white sports cars drive in formation down a tree-lined road, filmed from another car, then park side by side under a motorway bridge while the camera circles their bronze rims, spoilers and exhausts. Music only, no speech.

A driver in a white racing suit takes his black helmet off a formula car, puts it on and fastens it, climbs into the tight cockpit, grips the button-covered steering wheel and drives off down the empty race track at sunrise.

In a cel-animated desert highway scene, a red sports car pulls alongside a slow beige camper van, speeds past it and swings in front. The camper shrinks in the distance while the grinning driver whoops and races ahead.

A young man in a white shirt and red shorts rides a skateboard through an empty airport car park, towing a hard-shell suitcase along beside him by its handle. He carries on down a glazed walkway, steps onto a travelator at sunset and glides out across the open roof deck past concrete bollards.

In a car park a man in a black t-shirt and cap stands beside a huge grey six-wheeled expedition truck with a living box built onto the back. He bends down at a rack on the truck's flank and pulls a black electric motorcycle out on its carrier, then stands holding it by the handlebars in front of the truck's giant wheels while he talks to the camera. He then walks through the wood-lined interior of the truck, past a black oven and microwave, a bed and a sink under a skylight, with two long-haired grey cats sitting on the counter and the bed.
videos.said: Yo, what is this? It's an electric motorcycle I charge off my truck. No, the truck. Oh, that's my house. Induction cooktop, full bed, even a skylight.

videos.desc: A rusted shipwreck stands tilted out of bright turquoise shallows under a sky of white clouds. A woman in a bikini runs along the wreck's raised bow, bends her knees and leaps off the end, stretching out flat as she flies over the water. She hits the surface and the shot follows her down in a stream of white bubbles. Underwater she levels off above a sandy bottom dotted with coral heads, where several large tiger sharks are cruising. She swims in among them and glides right alongside one, her arms wrapped loosely around its back, as a second shark passes behind.

A point-of-view shot from the front of a yellow kayak dropping into a white-water river in a steep pine gorge. The pale green water rushes past on both sides, piling into standing waves and white foam between dark rocks, and the boat is carried down fast. A hand works a black paddle across the bow, spray bursts over the lens and blurs it, and the walls of fir trees rush by. The river then widens and slows, and the kayak arrives at a calm stretch where four paddlers in red kayaks and helmets are waiting on a grey gravel bank.

A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a narrow dirt track that runs along a steep green alpine ridge, with deep valleys and misty mountains beyond. Two brown cows with bells around their necks are standing right on the track, blocking the only way through. One walks straight at the camera and the rider reaches out a gloved hand and pushes its face gently aside. The cows step off the path, and the rider rolls on down the empty track over the ridge.
videos.said: Excuse me, coming through. You going or am I going? Okay, I'm going.

videos.desc: A dark green sports car speeds along a narrow country road, filmed from a camera held close to its side so the grass at the roadside blurs past. Close-ups show the rear wing with the badge on it, and a gold wheel with a yellow brake spinning fast just above the gravel. Another shot runs along the green bonnet towards the road ahead. At the end the car stands still on a sandy track by the dunes with the sea behind it, and a man in a brown t-shirt walks up to it.

A large black closed trailer stands on a gravel drive in front of green summer trees, filmed from behind. Its whole back wall begins to tip down slowly, turning into a ramp. As the ramp lowers, the dark inside of the trailer appears and a pale grey sports car is revealed standing inside it. The ramp comes all the way down to the gravel so the car could be driven straight out.

A paraglider under a red and white wing flies along a grey rock face above a thick pine forest in the mountains. He comes down over a still turquoise lake and pulls his feet through the water, cutting a long white line of spray across the surface, with the whole red wing mirrored in the lake beneath him. He lifts away again, flies over the shore and drops onto a green meadow, where the wing sinks down behind him and a group of people sit at the edge of the grass watching.

Two riders on blue dirt bikes ride side by side across a wide beach at sunset. The sand is covered by a film of water that mirrors the pink and orange clouds so completely that the shot looks like sky above and below. Both riders pull the front wheels of their bikes off the ground and hold them there, so the machines stand almost vertical on their back wheels, their reflections rising to meet them in the wet sand. They ride on into the sunset still standing the bikes up on end.

A corgi sits at the wheel of an old rust-orange tractor and drives it down a narrow road through green vineyards on a sunny day. The camera stays in front of the tractor, filling the frame with its big ribbed radiator grille, round headlamps and upright exhaust pipe. Halfway through, a thick cloud of black smoke bursts from the exhaust pipe as the motor is worked harder, and the tractor keeps rolling towards the camera past the vines and a stone farmhouse on the hill.

A point-of-view shot from inside a go-kart: a driver in a bright striped racing suit grips the small steering wheel and speeds along a sunlit tarmac circuit with red and white kerbs, tyre barriers and eucalyptus trees, another kart running ahead. Then a duck waddles out onto the track in front, and the kart drops from full speed to a crawl and creeps along behind the bird until it has crossed.

A delivery driver in a hi-vis vest leans out of his van window in a narrow old town street where a parked lorry leaves him no room to pass. He edges into a market square full of crates and market stalls that leave no way through. Then, on a mountain road, a whole flock of sheep fills the tarmac from verge to verge and walks straight at the van; the driver leans out shouting while the shepherd waves him back and the sheep press against the door.

A man in a cap and dark T-shirt gets onto one vehicle after another. He climbs into a crowded minibus and squeezes past the other passengers with his bag. He steps up through the doors of a modern city bus and holds a travel card out to the card reader beside the driver. Inside, he stands in the aisle holding the rail while the bus, full of seated passengers, moves off. Then he climbs the steps of a red open-top tour bus, and sits on the top deck with both arms flung wide as the bus drives between skyscrapers.

In an open-plan office a young man in a denim jacket sits on a black office chair with his feet up and whirls himself round and round on it. He stops and stands up, but staggers sideways with his arms out and his eyes wide, and has to grab the edge of a desk to stay upright. He leans over the desk holding on, then slides down and sits on the floor holding his forehead while a colleague watches from behind.

A small propeller plane flies low over green grassland and releases a wooden crate from beneath its fuselage. The crate comes down under a parachute and lands in the grass, where a smiling woman in a striped robe runs up and takes hold of it by the handles. The plane circles back and drops a whole string of crates, each on its own coloured parachute, and the sky fills with them. Villagers walk out from their white round tents to collect the boxes, and the woman raises both arms towards the descending parachutes.

A man in blue overalls works in a workshop on a stripped scooter whose engine block sits exposed in the frame, tightening a part with a screwdriver and grinning at it. The shot cuts to an open car bonnet with the four-cylinder engine, belts, alternator and hoses in plain view. Then he is outside on the grass beside a huge chrome-topped V8 engine mounted on a black steel stand, first pushing it, then standing back with his hands on his head, astonished at the size of it.

A brown and white goat pushes its head out between the boards of a wooden gate in a barn pen where other goats are standing. It works its horns and shoulders through the gap and squeezes its whole body out of the pen. Outside, a farmer in a straw hat lunges for it past a row of feed sacks but misses, and the goat gallops off down a red dirt track between rows of olive trees, growing smaller as it runs away.

A man in a navy suit and a white hard hat presses a carved wooden sign into place above the door of a new stone building, then pulls a cord to drop the cloth covering beside it. Outside on the steps he hauls on a halyard and pulls a green flag up a tall white flagpole while a crowd of people in suits and hard hats claps and two drummers play. He then cuts a teal ribbon stretched across the steps and the crowd applauds.

A rainbow-striped spinning top spins on the hexagonal paving of a city park while a teenage boy circles around it with one leg swung out; more and more people join in, running in a wide ring around the spinning top while the city skyline glows behind them at sunset.

Swimmers splash and laugh in a calm blue lake; behind them a long dark grey military submarine rises out of the water with its conning tower streaming water, and then a humpback whale breaches beside it and throws spray over the swimmers.

A young man in a grey hoodie jogs along a suburban pavement in golden evening light. In close-up he takes a full paper grocery bag from an elderly woman's hands. Carrying a bag under each arm, he climbs the flight of steps up to her house, where the white-haired woman waits smiling by the porch railing. His hand steadies a loaded shopping trolley rolling along the pavement. Finally he stands beside her and gives a thumbs-up to the camera.

A hand pats the lit TAXI sign on the roof of a yellow cab, with tall city buildings behind it. From alongside the moving car we see it driving down a wide avenue into a low sun, other traffic ahead. Inside, over the shoulder of the driver, a young woman in a flat cap, white shirt and dark waistcoat holds the steering wheel with one hand and turns it as she follows the car in front through the traffic. She then leans out of the open driver's window at the kerb, grinning at the camera, and finally raises her hand to the brim of her cap and tips it.

A selfie travel clip in three beats. A young man in a yellow jacket with a camera round his neck holds the phone out on a crowded city crossing at dusk, with lit screens and pedestrians behind him. Then the camera moves forward down a long shaded passage formed by hundreds of orange shrine gates standing one behind the other, with a bright opening far ahead at the end. Finally he sits at a lit night stall under red paper lanterns and eats a bowl of ramen with chopsticks.

Under floodlights on a small caged pitch, a footballer in a yellow number 10 shirt takes the ball past a defender in dark blue, drives into space and finishes. He runs towards the goal, drops down onto his knees on the grass and stays there, head back, mouth wide open, shouting, until a teammate in the same yellow shirt arrives and grabs him round the shoulders while spectators press against the fence behind them.

A sunny mown grass field under a clear blue sky. A teenage boy in a white t-shirt and black shorts leans right back and hauls a thick rope towards himself hand over hand, face screwed up with the strain. The camera pulls back and the other end of the rope turns out to be tied to a green two-wheeled farm wagon, which rolls slowly across the grass behind him. He gets it moving, drops the rope and grins.

Three friends are having a picnic on a checked blanket in a park by a pond when a big white goose marches straight at them. They shuffle backwards with their hands raised, one still clutching a sandwich; as the goose spreads its wings they scramble to their feet and run off across the grass, abandoning the blanket. The goose stands on the blanket over the sandwiches, honking, while the group watches from a safe distance further down the path.

A woman in a long yellow dress with a film camera round her neck walks slowly through a narrow lantern-lit alley at dusk, then wanders between the stalls of a night flower market, and finally steps out onto a rooftop and spreads her arms in front of a city skyline at sunset.

A hiker with a rucksack traces a red line across a laminated map with her finger, checks a trail information board at the edge of a forest, runs up a dusty path past a boulder painted with a red-and-white waymark, then climbs a long flight of stone steps built into the mountainside, and at the top holds the map up to the camera and points at the line she has just walked.

A woman in a light blue uniform shirt and a peaked cap with a winged badge stands in a container terminal, checking papers on a clipboard that already carry round red marks. She lifts a heavy red stamp over her head and brings it down hard, first on the paperwork and then on the lids of big wooden shipping crates lined up on a rack, watched by dockworkers in hi-vis vests. The shot then runs down a long aisle between walls of stacked shipping containers, with gantry cranes lowering their spreaders overhead and a forklift parked among more crates, and ends with her standing alone in the middle of the aisle.

A trail of big muddy footprints runs the whole length of a white tiled hallway. A small elderly woman in an apron stands at one end holding a mop and wags her finger at a large young man in a black T-shirt who is holding a motorcycle helmet; his boots and his dog are both caked in mud. She hands him the mop, he lowers his head and takes it, and starts pushing it over the prints while the dog sits and watches.

In a sunlit flat with a mustard-yellow sofa and many houseplants, a woman rearranges the living room. She pulls the sofa across the parquet floor into a new position, kneels to push the oval coffee table onto the rug and straightens the books and vase on it, then lifts a large abstract canvas onto the wall above a wooden shelf unit. The last shot is filmed from the doorway: she sits down on the sofa and spreads her arms out along its back.

A young man films himself with an outstretched arm on a small country railway platform while an orange and grey train pulls in behind him on the rails; he is holding a croissant. The shot cuts to him walking through a busy indoor railway station under big departure boards, commuters and rolling suitcases around him and the croissant in his mouth. He ends alone on a wide platform under a huge arched glass roof, tracks running away on both sides, looking up into the light.

A woman in a denim shirt sits in the driver's seat of a small parked car with her seat belt on, both hands on the steering wheel, turning it one way and then the other and watching where the car points. The shot cuts to the same woman in the driver's cab of a city bus, taking hold of a huge flat steering wheel with both hands and turning it, grinning at how big it is, with buses and the depot visible through the windscreen.
